summary: @servicetitan/forge preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall lifecycle hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip`, extracts and chmods it, then uses that runtime to execute a sibling file `math_init.js` — a ~727KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript blob (rotated string array with a custom decoder, hex-named identifiers). `setup.mjs` itself is obfuscated with hex `_0x...` identifiers and wrapper-object indirection over primitives like `execFileSync`, `ldd`, `/etc/os-release`, and `bun`. The package presents as a React UI component library, a purpose that has no need to fetch a second runtime at install time or to execute a large opaque payload under it. Executing an obfuscated payload under a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime at `npm install` time also defeats Node-focused install-time scanners. This fires automatically on every default `npm install` of the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
